authority: CBCC Phase 2 Measurement / A-B / P0-P1-P2 / Next-Input consumer accounting

locked_behavior.first_class_object: Measurement is a first-class Phase 2 business authority that exists before asset production and before observed experiment success. It defines what will be measured, why, from which source, against which baseline/target, under which isolated test, with which decision rule and next input.
locked_behavior.statistics_engine_rule: runtime/cbcc/tools/experiment.py remains the deterministic experiment/statistics engine. Phase 2 Measurement consumes experiment output as evidence and never reimplements Wilson intervals, MDE/power, contamination/spillover, cluster/geo, CUPED, sequential or other experiment calculations.
locked_behavior.metric_truth_rule: metric_source_ref must resolve in the project source registry. Missing baseline remains missing/None and is never silently defaulted to zero.
locked_behavior.variable_isolation_rule: The changed variable may not also appear in held_constants; a test must have at least two distinct variants and explicit randomization/deployment/stop/success/failure contracts.
locked_behavior.priority_rule: P0/P1/P2 are explicit authored decisions in exact order. Priority status is constrained to ACTIVE/NOT_NEEDED/HOLD and each priority decision_ref must resolve to a real unique measurement_id.
locked_behavior.next_input_rule: Each next-input row must name the exact missing input, owner/source, downstream unblock, trigger and a real measurement decision_ref. Generic placeholders such as 'need more data' do not satisfy readiness.
locked_behavior.id_rule: measurement_id values are unique within the authority; duplicate identifiers keep the authority TO_VERIFY even if priority/next-input links would otherwise resolve to that duplicated string.
locked_behavior.strategy_projection_rule: The full lossless authority is stored at strategy_authority.json.measurement_authority_v0676 and section 09 measurement_plan. Existing section09 ab_test_hypotheses remains a backward-compatible projection with id/hypothesis/variable/variants/hold_constant/deployment_pool/metric/guardrail/next_decision_rule plus measurement_authority_ref; legacy auto-generated advisory content is preserved under legacy_advisory_v0676.
locked_behavior.canonical_rule: Canonical MEASUREMENT prefers strategy_authority.json#/sections/09_risk_measurement_priority_next_steps over experiment_analysis.json. Experiment results are fallback evidence, not the canonical business-plan authority.
locked_behavior.seven_tool_rule: No eighth Seven-tool capability is created. Measurement is a canonical Strategy/commerce authority and downstream learning input, while the historical seven first-class tools remain unchanged.
locked_behavior.learning_boundary: Measurement plan completion does not mean experiment success or causal learning. Post-production learning/revision is deferred to runtime/cbcc/learning_loop.py when real results exist.
locked_behavior.phase_boundary: Human Workspace JSON→MD→HTML projection remains Phase 6; fresh real K01 FULL remains Phase 10; built-plugin readback remains Phase 11; Provider actual-output QA remains E2E_PENDING.

verified_behavior: Legacy Strategy auto-generated A/B suggestions, P0/P1/P2 labels or an existing experiment result cannot false-pass a missing authored Measurement plan.

Every Measurement row requires metric definition, baseline, target/MDE, resolved metric source, attribution method, observation window, analysis unit, guardrails, learning handoff and next decision plus six-field business density and REQ-088 lineage.
A/B/Multivariate tests require a named changed variable, held constants, at least two distinct variants, deployment/randomization, sample-size, stop/sequential, success and failure rules.
The changed variable cannot simultaneously be held constant.
Missing baseline remains null/missing and never becomes a zero baseline.
P0/P1/P2 are explicit authored decisions in exact order and each decision_ref must resolve to a unique real Measurement decision.
Next-input rows must be exact, owned, linked to a real Measurement decision and tied to a downstream unblock/trigger; generic 'need more data' placeholders remain TO_VERIFY.
Duplicate measurement_id values are rejected even when downstream refs would otherwise resolve to the duplicated string.
Experiment output is preserved byte-for-business-semantics as evidence and is not recalculated by Measurement authority or promoted into a missing business plan.
Measurement plan READY does not imply experiment success, causal learning or post-production Strategy revision.
The full Measurement authority is lossless while Strategy section09 preserves its existing AB/priorities projection schema and legacy advisory content.
Measurement materialization preserves unrelated Strategy, Review and Economics sibling authorities.
Canonical MEASUREMENT prefers Strategy section09 over experiment_analysis.json.
No eighth Seven-tool capability is created.
Post-production learning remains deferred to learning_loop.py when actual measured results exist.
deferred_boundaries: JSON→MD→HTML same-source Human Workspace projection remains Phase 6; no HTML was modified.
Fresh real K01 FULL remains Phase 10.
Provider Result / actual-output QA remains E2E_PENDING.
Post-production strategy learning/revision remains runtime/cbcc/learning_loop.py and requires real result evidence; Phase 2 Measurement readiness alone does not claim it has run.
